interface.name: hyprland_ctm_control_manager_v1
interface.description: This protocol allows a client to control outputs' color transform matrix (CTM). This protocol is privileged and should not be exposed to unprivileged clients.

request.name: set_ctm_for_output

description.summary: set a CTM for an output

event.name: blocked
event.description: This event is sent if another manager was bound by any client at the time the current manager was bound. Requests from a blocked manager are ignored by the compositor.
